Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

  • Champion digital and AI adoption within your teams, identifying opportunities to automate or augment work and building the capability to do so.

  • Identify and mitigate operational risks before they become incidents; when they do, own the response and retrospective.

  • Oversee the Office Administrator and our external IT vendor, ensuring the workplace and facilities run smoothly without requiring senior attention.

  • Proven experience running multi-team customer operations at scale - you’ve managed complex functions, not just coordinated them.

  • Exceptional process and systems thinking - you build repeatable, scalable ways of working for client supporting teams and have low tolerance for avoidable inefficiency.

  • A track record of incident and crisis management: calm under pressure, methodical in response, and effective at containing operational issues without escalating them unnecessarily.

  • Strong line management experience, including managing through team leads and developing operational managers.

  • Data-driven: you measure what matters, spot problems in the numbers before they surface elsewhere, and prioritise accordingly.

  • A bias for action and ownership - you don’t wait to be asked, and you don’t leave ambiguous problems to someone else.

  • Background in health tech, healthcare or an adjacent regulated industry

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience embedding AI or automation into operational workflows - either personally or by leading teams to do so.

  • A strong understanding of data protection obligations and clinical governance requirements.

As a Graduate Full Stack Engineer, you'll join a single squad and contribute across both frontend and backend under the guidance of more experienced engineers. The role exists to learn fast and ship small, well-tested changes that help our customers.

This role is ideal for someone who has recently graduated from a leading university and is excited about applying modern software engineering practices to real business problems. You may not have extensive industry experience yet, but you have demonstrated your capabilities through academic projects, internships, hackathons, research, open-source contributions, or personal projects.

You'll build your skills in Spring Boot microservices (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript), working with containerised services on Azure Container Apps and web applications deployed via Azure Static Web Apps.

Allica is expanding internationally, establishing a regulated entity in its first international market and deploying the proprietary technology platform there.

The platform model is deliberately repeatable, so that further markets can be added if and when the opportunity arises. The purpose of this role is to design and implement a repeatable international platform model, prove it in the first market, and enable each local entity to operate its own identity and local access services within centrally governed technology, security and identity standards.

The role owns the international Azure platform end to end, from design and build through ongoing run. Identity is delivered on a build-and-hand-over basis: the role designs and implements each entity's Entra environment, then transitions day-to-day operation to the local team, remaining involved for enhancement rather than implementation. Both sit within a governance model where technical controls are defined centrally by Allica's UK platform and security functions, and each international entity operates as a consumer of those controls with local attestation.

Multi-market platform foundations, delivered as code

  • Design and build a parameterised Azure landing zone that can be instantiated per market, covering subscription and management group topology, networking, connectivity, policy assignment, and baseline observability.

  • Make market-specific variation explicit and narrow — a small, documented set of local deltas over a common baseline, rather than a fork.

data.title: Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
data.description:
Build the security foundations behind cutting-edge construction technology

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, our technology – and the security environment supporting it – is becoming increasingly sophisticated.

Our stack spans Kubernetes on Azure, mobile and embedded AR, REST APIs, real-time collaboration and AI-powered data pipelines. We already hold SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but as our product, customers and use of AI continue to evolve, we now need dedicated security expertise within the business.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Security & Compliance Engineer to take ownership of security across XYZ Reality and help build a security capability that can scale with us.

The Role

This is a critical hire and an opportunity to become our first dedicated security specialist, with genuine ownership and influence across the business.

While we already have established compliance activity and SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, security responsibilities currently sit across different teams. We’re now looking for someone who can bring that together, identify where we need to strengthen our approach and provide dedicated technical security leadership as we scale.

This is first and foremost a technical security role. You’ll sit within Engineering and work directly alongside the teams building our technology, participating in architecture discussions, development workflows and technical decision-making rather than operating as a separate security function reviewing work after the fact.

You’ll take ownership of security architecture across our technology stack, embed shift-left security practices into how we build, strengthen our cloud and application security, and ensure we remain ahead of both established and emerging threats.

As our use of AI continues to develop, you’ll also help us understand and respond to new AI-related security risks and attack vectors, ensuring our security approach evolves alongside our technology.

Compliance remains an important part of the role. You’ll help strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture and support areas including GDPR, data residency and enterprise customer requirements. However, we’re looking for someone who brings strong hands-on security expertise first, alongside the governance and compliance knowledge needed to operate effectively across both areas.

You won’t simply inherit a security playbook, you’ll have the opportunity to help build one.

The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work closely with our Engineering, Product and wider business teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Take ownership of security architecture and technical security across XYZ Reality’s technology environment.

  • Assess our current security posture, identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, and develop pragmatic remediation plans.

  • Architect and strengthen security across our Azure cloud environment, including Kubernetes clusters, databases and data pipelines.

  • Own and improve areas including IAM, zero-trust networking, secrets management, RBAC, pod security and encryption.

  • Embed shift-left security into engineering workflows, integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning and SCA into our CI/CD pipelines.

  • Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams on architectural decisions, technical trade-offs and secure-by-design development.

  • Run threat-modelling exercises and support developers with secure coding practices across Node.js, React Native and C++ environments.

  • Own vulnerability management, including triage, risk prioritisation, remediation tracking and incident response where required.

  • Develop and improve the logging, monitoring and alerting capabilities needed to identify and respond to security threats.

  • Assess emerging threats, including those associated with AI-enabled products, tooling and new attack methodologies, and ensure our security approach continues to evolve.

  • Strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 controls, identifying gaps and improving implementation where needed.

  • Support compliance cycles including controls testing, evidence gathering and auditor coordination.

  • Support GDPR and data residency requirements across our infrastructure and data pipelines.

  • Engage with enterprise customers and prospects on XYZ Reality’s security posture when required.

  • Automate security controls and processes wherever possible rather than relying on manual intervention.

  • Help establish the standards, tooling and operating model for a security capability that can scale with the business.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrable in-depth hands-on technical security experience, ideally spanning application, cloud and/or infrastructure security.

  • Strong technical security capability and the confidence to own security decisions end-to-end rather than operating purely in an advisory or governance capacity.

  • Strong cloud security experience, ideally Azure, although significant AWS or GCP expertise with the ability to transition quickly to Azure would also be considered.

  • Hands-on experience securing Kubernetes/containerised environments, including IAM, RBAC, network segmentation, secrets management, image scanning and pod security.

  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD environments, including SAST, DAST, SCA and dependency scanning.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code security and technologies such as Terraform, Helm or GitOps.

  • Understanding of application and API security, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS and secure development practices.

  • Experience identifying vulnerabilities, assessing technical risk and driving remediation.

  • Comfortable writing automation using Python, Go, Bash or similar to operationalise security controls.

  • Practical experience working with SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001, including identifying gaps and strengthening controls.

  • Current knowledge of the evolving cybersecurity landscape and an interest in emerging threats, particularly those associated with AI.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate security requirements for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach, you understand that great security enables engineering teams rather than creating unnecessary barriers.

Experience building or scaling security capability within a high-growth or Series A/B technology business would be particularly valuable. You’ll understand the balance between addressing today’s risks and building security foundations capable of supporting where the business is heading next.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who is technically strong, curious and proactive, someone engineers want to work with, who can bring credibility to security conversations while remaining pragmatic about how we build and ship great technology.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact across areas including:

  • Azure and Kubernetes security architecture

  • Application and API security

  • Secure software development and shift-left security

  • Vulnerability management and incident response

  • AI-related security and emerging threat management

  • SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 maturity

  • Security automation and CI/CD integration

  • Enterprise customer security requirements

  • Building XYZ Reality’s longer-term security capability and roadmap

Why Join Us

  • 🔐 Become our first dedicated security hire and have genuine ownership over how security develops at XYZ Reality

  • 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office

  • 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

  • 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

  • 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

  • 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

  • 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events

  • 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings

  • 💰 Employee referral scheme

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

If you’re an experienced security engineer who wants more than maintaining an established security programme, and you’re excited by the opportunity to build, influence and own security within a growing technology business, we’d love to hear from you.

Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
data.description:

As a Field Marketing Manager at Siteimprove, you will lead the strategy and execution of high-impact field marketing initiatives that drive demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and brand growth across international markets, with a primary focus on our EU markets. This role owns regional field marketing strategy and associated pipeline targets, translating global priorities into locally relevant, scalable programs that directly support revenue objectives. 

You are an experienced strategic partner to regional sales leadership, responsible for shaping integrated inbound and outbound marketing programs, influencing go-to-market plans, and optimizing investment based on performance insights. With a deep understanding of regional market dynamics and buyer behavior, you will proactively identify growth opportunities, guide program prioritization, and continuously refine field marketing approaches through data-driven analysis. This role also serves as a key connector between global marketing, sales, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, consistency, and measurable business impact.


What you will be doing
  • Strategic Planning and Execution: 
    Own the regional field marketing strategy, developing and executing integrated, multi-channel plans that align with global priorities while addressing regional market dynamics to drive sustained demand generation, pipeline growth, and brand impact to meet regional pipe goals. 

  • Event Strategy and Management: 
    Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of high-impact regional and multi-market events—including conferences, trade shows, executive programs, webinars, and roadshows—ensuring clear objectives, strong sales alignment, and measurable contribution to pipeline and revenue. 

  • Campaign Localization and Optimization: 
    Serve as the regional expert in adapting and scaling global campaigns, ensuring they are localized effectively to meet market needs, resonate with target audiences, and deliver consistent brand messaging while maximizing performance. 

  • Demand Generation and Funnel Ownership: 
    Design, execute, and optimize comprehensive demand generation and lead nurturing programs across the full buyer journey, partnering with sales to influence pipeline velocity, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes. 

  • Sales Partnership and Stakeholder Leadership: 
    Act as a strategic partner to regional sales leadership, collaborating on go-to-market planning, account-based initiatives, and territory priorities to improve lead quality, sales enablement, and overall marketing impact. 

  • Performance Measurement and Data-Driven Decision Making: 
    Define success metrics, analyze performance data, and leverage market insights to continuously optimize programs, inform investment decisions, and clearly communicate results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 

  • Integrated Multi-Channel Campaign Leadership: 
    Lead the development and execution of integrated campaigns across email, digital advertising, social, and other channels, ensuring cohesive execution, consistent messaging, and alignment from strategy through delivery. 

  • Brand Leadership and Regional Positioning: 
    Champion brand consistency and positioning across assigned regions, ensuring a strong, differentiated, and locally relevant brand presence across all field marketing initiatives. 

  • Budget Ownership and Resource Allocation: 
    Own and manage regional field marketing budgets, making strategic investment decisions to maximize ROI, scale high-performing initiatives, and balance short-term impact with long-term growth. 

  • Marketing Technology and Enablement: 
    Leverage and optimize marketing technology platforms—including Pardot, HubSpot, 6sense, and CRM systems—to improve campaign execution, targeting, measurement, and reporting, while driving best practices across the region. 

  • Additional Leadership Contributions: 
    Contribute to broader field marketing initiatives, mentor junior team members as needed, and support cross-functional projects that advance regional and global marketing objectives.

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in field marketing or demand generation roles, with demonstrated success driving pipeline and revenue impact within enterprise IT and/or B2B SaaS environments across one or more European regions; namely UKI, Nordics or Benelux. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience delivering complex, multi-market marketing programs.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
data.description:
Redpanda is the first runtime and control plane for agent-data interaction — a unified platform that combines streaming, SQL analytics, and intelligent connectivity with the governance layer enterprise AI agents need in production.

Built on infrastructure already trusted by Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing startups, Redpanda enforces governance entirely outside the agent's data path, controlling what agents see, limiting what they do, and capturing a tamper-proof record of everything they touch, so organizations never have to choose between innovation and control.

About the Role: 

Redpanda is building the Agentic Data Plane (ADP) — the streaming and data infrastructure the world’s largest enterprises run mission-critical agents on. The enterprises winning right now are building agents that encode their own business logic, their own data, their own institutional knowledge into production-grade infrastructure. That’s digital sovereignty, and Redpanda ADP is the infrastructure layer that makes it real.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is the delivery arm. We embed engineers directly with strategic customers and build the agents and integrations that turn ADP into owned outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the builder: embedded on-site, working inside the customer’s environment, writing the code that ships.

This is not a solutions engineering role. You are not here to demo or advise. You are here to build — agents, integrations, data pipelines, and the infrastructure that runs them — alongside a customer team, in their environment, on their timeline.

You Will:  

  • Build at the customer site. Write production-quality agents, integrations, and data pipelines on Redpanda ADP, inside the customer’s environment and codebase. What you ship has to work after you leave. 

  • Work in unfamiliar territory, fast. Every customer engagement is a new codebase, a new data environment, a new set of constraints. Ramp quickly, orient to what exists, build on top of it without breaking it.

  • Own the technical deliverable. Understand what the engagement is supposed to produce, design the technical approach, build it, and hand it off clean — documented, maintainable, and running in production.

  • Be the Redpanda technical voice with the customer’s engineers. Work alongside their team daily. Earn their trust. Make sure the work integrates correctly with what they already have and what they’ll maintain after you leave.

  • Drive toward exit from day one. Build with handoff in mind. Write documentation that their team can actually use. Train them on what you built. Don’t create dependencies on you.

  • Feed learnings back. Identify patterns across engagements — what customers keep needing to build, where ADP makes things hard, what should be productized. Bring that back to Product and Engineering clearly.

You Have: 

  • Engineering depth. You write production software. You’ve built backend systems, data pipelines, APIs, or agent systems that ran in production and had real consequences when they broke. Language background is flexible; what matters is that you build things that work.

  • Agent and integration experience. You’ve built agents, worked with LLM APIs, or built integrations between complex systems. You know what makes an agent reliable vs. brittle, and you’ve made that call in production.

  • Ability to operate in any environment. You’ve worked in someone else’s codebase, with constraints you didn’t set, in a stack you didn’t choose. You can read unfamiliar code, understand what it does, and extend it without breaking it.

  • Customer-facing communication. You can work directly with a customer’s engineering team — their leads, their architects, their individual contributors — and be a credible, trusted technical partner. You don’t need a PM to translate for you.

  • Shipped at a customer site or in a deployment context. You’ve personally been in the room when something hard went live. You know the difference between a demo and a production deployment.

Bonus:

  • Experience in a forward-deployed or customer-embedded engineering model — Anthropic FDE, OpenAI Deployed Engineer, Stripe FDE, Sierra, Palantir FDSE, or analogous.

  • Background in streaming or real-time data systems (Kafka, Flink, Redpanda, or similar).

  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector) or air-gapped environments.

  • Have been the first or only technical person in a customer engagement — run it end-to-end without a playbook.

How We Work:

  • Reports to: Head of FDE 

  • Travel: 30–50% during active engagements; lighter between engagements. You’ll be on-site when the build is live.

data.title: Technical Support Engineer
data.description:
About You

You’re a customer-obsessed technologist in the EMEA market who thrives at the intersection of technical support, customer enablement, and impact. With a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience working with APIs, SDKs, logs, and data integrations, you’re driven by helping customers resolve issues quickly, understand what is happening, and get back to making progress. You will be the first full time support engineer on the newly formed support team.

You build trust quickly with both technical and business stakeholders, translating complex systems into clear, actionable next steps. You’re comfortable communicating complex technical solutions in a written form, and you know how to keep customers informed while you investigate. You’re a problem solver who’s passionate about removing roadblocks, creating scalable solutions, and championing the customer’s voice at every stage. You’re a strong troubleshooter who is passionate about removing roadblocks, improving support processes, and making it easier for customers and internal teams to get to the right answer faster. For you, every support interaction is a chance to earn trust and leave the customer better off than when they reached out.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, explicitly optimizing for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world, including some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who loves solving problems and making our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S.-based company that has been in the market since 2015. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick, who still lead the company today.

About the Position

As a Technical Support Engineer on our EMEA team, you’ll be part of the support-founding team, a reliable technical resource for enterprise customers, helping them troubleshoot issues, understand Constructor behavior, and move forward with confidence. You’ll own and drive customer-facing technical support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, especially for issues involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, event instrumentation, tagging, and implementation behavior. You'll act as a supportive partner, bridging the gap between technical issues and successful resolutions, ensuring customers feel supported throughout each interaction.You’ll investigate technical hurdles, communicate clearly while work is in progress, coordinate with internal teams when escalation is needed, and make sure customers understand the resolution and next steps.

You can dive into a payload or a log review, drive technical implementation guides and communicate clear solutions in tickets with equal ease, but consistently earning trust within every interaction is what sets you apart. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, high-quality customer communication, and improving the systems that help a support team scale.

You will…

  • Provide clear, timely, and technically sound support on complex inbound questions involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, tagging, event instrumentation, and implementation behavior.

  • Own customer-facing technical support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, making sure customers understand what we know, what we are investigating, and what happens next.

  • Earn trust across technical and business stakeholders by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and distilling complex technical issues into simple, actionable next steps.

  • Troubleshoot issues by reviewing payloads, logs, API behavior, configuration, and implementation details, then guiding customers toward a resolution.

  • Review and improve self-service bot answers, flag automation gaps, and help tune escalation criteria.

  • Support in creating and maintaining knowledge base and documentation.

  • Support EMEA customers with responsiveness, strong written communication, and ownership during regional business hours.

  • Identify patterns in customer tickets, recurring questions, and support pain points, then share clear feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the customer experience.

  • Collaborate with customer developers, data teams, Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot issues, clarify implementation questions, and support successful resolutions.

  • Proactively investigate and resolve blockers across data ingestion, tagging, event instrumentation, and API performance, especially when those blockers affect launch, customer confidence, or ongoing platform usage.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Constructor’s technical architecture, helping customers understand expected behavior, integration options, and how to troubleshoot issues in their environment.

  • Translate customer issues into clear internal context for Product and Engineering, including impact, reproduction steps, examples, urgency, and customer-facing implications.

  • Create and improve reusable technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, macros, internal notes, and support workflows that help the team resolve issues more consistently and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Solutions, Product, and Engineering so customers receive consistent guidance and internal teams have the context they need.

  • Continuously improve support processes, playbooks, and escalation paths to reduce friction, improve response quality, and help customers get to value faster.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or customer-facing engineering role.

  • Hands-on experience working with APIs, SDKs, logs, HTTP requests, event data, and technical implementation details.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially in tickets, Slack, and customer calls, with the ability to explain technical complexity in simple, actionable language.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, including situations with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high urgency.

  • Ability to manage customer expectations, communicate clearly under pressure, and drive issues forward across internal and external teams.

  • Track record of building or improving support processes, documentation, troubleshooting guides, or tooling that improves team efficiency and customer outcomes.

  • Proven ability to manage complex technical support cases from intake to resolution, balancing speed, accuracy, customer communication, and internal escalation when needed.

  • Strong desire to learn quickly, adapt, and improve how we support customers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Familiarity with JavaScript-based web integrations, HTTP request flows, browser developer tools, and client-side / server-side contexts is a plus, but customer communication, not coding, is your superpower.

  • Ability to support customers during EMEA business hours.

  • Bonus: familiarity with A/B testing, ecommerce search or discovery, network request routing, and HTTP troubleshooting.

Benefits

 

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time. We strongly encourage all employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options.

🌎 Fully remote team. Choose where you live.

🛋️ Work from home stipend. We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. data.title: Data Engineer
data.description:
About Us 

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential.

What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond 
Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources 
A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement 
Flexible working with a remote first working policy

Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you

Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers

At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are keen to hear from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions and would be happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments needed during the recruitment process.

data.description:
Delivery Manager – Biomechanics

Join Our Team at Sony Sports Technology

Value Stream: Biomechanics

Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Office locations: Basingstoke, London or Bristol

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Salary: £42,000 - £66,000

 

About the Team

Hi, we're Amy Ogren and Robert Hulbert, and we're looking for a Delivery Manager to join our growing Biomechanics Value Stream. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing areas within Sony Sports Technology. Our team combines Hawk-Eye's world-leading tracking technology with KinaTrax's markerless motion capture systems to provide cutting-edge athlete performance insights across elite sport.

You'll be joining a collaborative team of around 20 people that's expected to grow to approximately 25 over the coming year. Unlike many delivery roles that focus on a single product or sport, you'll support initiatives across Major League Baseball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, cricket, tennis and golf.

You'll also be joining at an exciting time as we continue delivering one of Sony Sports Technology's largest strategic partnerships while helping shape the future of biomechanics technology.

 

About the Role

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems and helping technical teams deliver their best work.

As a Delivery Manager, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Solution Owners and software engineers to coordinate the delivery of technical initiatives across our biomechanics products.

You'll help keep projects moving by managing priorities, coordinating dependencies, identifying risks early and ensuring teams have the information they need to deliver successfully.

This isn't a traditional project management role. Priorities can change quickly as new opportunities emerge across multiple sports, so we're looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where no two weeks are quite the same.

 

What You'll Work On

  • Supporting delivery across multiple biomechanics products and sports initiatives.

  • Coordinating work across engineering, product and operational teams.

  • Managing delivery roadmaps, milestones and project planning activities.

  • Supporting Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and delivery processes.

  • Tracking project progress and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery.

  • Identifying risks, dependencies and blockers before they impact delivery.

  • Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads and Solution Owners to coordinate priorities.

  • Helping improve delivery processes and ways of working across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Building strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders across Sony Sports Technology.

 

What Success Looks Like

Your first few months will focus on learning the products, understanding how our teams work and building strong relationships across the business.

As your confidence grows, you'll begin taking ownership of delivery activities, supporting roadmap planning, identifying delivery risks and helping improve the way the team collaborates.

Success in this role isn't about changing everything on day one. It's about learning quickly, building trust and becoming someone the team relies on to help deliver complex technical projects successfully.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the successful delivery of initiatives across the Biomechanics Value Stream.

  • Maintain delivery roadmaps, milestones and project timelines across multiple workstreams.

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and backlog refinement.

  • Track project dependencies, risks and blockers, ensuring they are managed proactively.

  • Support Product Managers and Engineering Leads with delivery planning and prioritisation.

  • Monitor delivery health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.

  • Escalate delivery risks with clear recommendations and proposed mitigation plans.

  • Help improve Agile delivery practices, team collaboration and operational efficiency.

  • Support cross-functional communication between engineering, product, operations and business teams.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency and accountability.

 

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

We're looking for someone with:

  • Experience supporting software, technical or product delivery within a technology environment.

  • An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

  • Experience using Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration and planning tools.

  • Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working alongside engineering or technical teams.

  • A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

  • A genuine interest in technology and delivering high-quality products.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to sports technology or biomechanics.

  • Experience working across multiple technical teams.

  • An understanding of software development lifecycles.

  • A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Sports Science, Biomechanics, Project Management or a related discipline is preferred, but not essential.

 

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join one of the most exciting growth areas within Sony Sports Technology.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers and delivery specialists on technology that's helping redefine athlete performance analysis across professional sport.

As the Biomechanics Value Stream continues to expand, you'll have the opportunity to broaden your experience across multiple sports, contribute to high-profile programmes and develop your career within a growing global team.

Reward, Benefits & Wellness

At Sony Sports Technology, we believe our people are our greatest strength. Alongside the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology that's shaping the future of sport, you'll have access to a range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, development and work-life balance.

  • 25 days annual leave (excluding bank holidays)

  • Enhanced pension scheme with 5% employer matching

  • Hybrid working model

  • Complimentary Unmind wellbeing app

  • Onsite gym (Basingstoke)

  • Sony Group employee discounts

  • Career development opportunities across Sony Sports Technology

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Sports Technology is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

We employ, retain, promote and treat all employees and applicants fairly based on skills, qualifications and professional experience. Our commitment is to provide a respectful and inclusive environment where people can contribute, develop and succeed.

data.title: Commercial Finance Manager, Technology
data.description:
Location: Hybrid; you’ll spend 2-3 days per week at our office in London or Basingstoke, as well as working from home.

Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Start Date: ASAP

 

About Us:

Hawk-Eye Innovations is a vital part of Sony Sports Technology, whose mission is to revolutionise sports with cutting-edge technology. Hawk-Eye delivers precision tracking, immersive broadcast, and flawless officiating, enhancing fan experiences worldwide.

About Hawk-Eye Finance:

Hawk-Eye Finance comprises two teams: Commercial Finance and Accounting. The Accounting team is responsible for all accounting transactions, processes, reporting, and policies governance, including actuals analysis and reporting insights. Commercial Finance focuses on forward-looking planning and analysis, including forecasting, budgeting, deal analysis, and general business partnering.

About the Role:

The Commercial Finance Manager role is in the Commercial Finance team, and will partner with our CTO and Technology Organisation. The role reports directly to Hawk-Eye's Finance Director, with regular interaction with Hawk-Eye and Sony Sports leadership. This role has real P&L impact, as R&D is one of our biggest areas of spend in the business.

 

Responsibilities include: 

  • Business partnering: Act as the trusted finance partner to the CTO and technology leadership team, providing financial insight to support short- and long-term decision-making. Own the financials for Tech - from headcount to AI and tooling spend; to capex modelling and strategy; to investment tracking and ROI reporting.

  • Budgeting & forecasting: Own the annual budget, monthly re-forecasts, and long-range planning for the technology organisation.

  • Headcount planning: Partner on workforce planning and reporting, given the people-intensive nature of and R&D organisation.

  • Financial infrastructure build-out: Build reporting infrastructure and mechanisms from the ground up, including: headcount reporting and planning, capitalisation and tax credit models, product P&Ls, R&D investment frameworks and ROI models, among others.

  • Reporting & analysis: Deliver regular management reporting, variance analysis, and KPIs relevant to technology (e.g., cost per project, delivery efficiency). Build and own cloud spend, AI tooling, and engineering software models. Identify opportunities to optimise spend, including cloud/SaaS costs and vendor contracts.

  • Investment appraisal: Build business cases and ROI analysis for new products, tools, and technology investments as well as tech debt mitigation

 

About You

  • You’re a commercially-minded finance partner for a business unit or department.

  • You've worked in fast-paced, high-performing teams before, and you know what good finance partnering looks like.

  • You’re collaborative, open-minded, and are good at earning trust.

  • You’re a problem solver: not afraid of taking on new challenges and finding creative ways to answer complex questions.

  • You can dive deep into technical details, handle complex, technical modelling, and also have sound business judgment.

  • You love to learn and embrace the chance to learn new skills and approaches, and share best practices with the team. You are a good writer and can communicate complex and technical concepts with structure and clarity.

  • You’re experienced in or curious about modern financial software platforms and AI tools, such as Abacum and Claude. You seek out efficiency and automation.

You've got solid skills in:

  • Modelling and analysis - including headcount modelling

  • Finance concepts (eg capitalisation, investment analysis, impairment review; etc.)

  • Verbal and written presentation

  • Multi-stakeholder/matrix management and project management

  • Finance tech, including spreadsheets, Abacum (or similar), automation, AI tools

  • It would be helpful but not essential if you understand SQL, AWS/cloud ops, and the sports entertainment industry.

Why Join Hawk-Eye?

This is a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of sports technology within a global, high-growth company. Your contributions will directly impact Hawk-Eye’s continued innovation and success, working alongside talented teams across the world.

Hawk-Eye Innovations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

data.title: People Operations Coordinator
data.description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

As People Operations Coordinator, you'll be the backbone of global people operations - the person who keeps core processes running smoothly, is the go-to for employee questions and ensures we stay compliant across every market we operate in.

This is a broad, hands-on role in a global, fast-changing business. You'll be building and running processes designed to scale as we grow, not just maintaining what already exists, and you'll need to be comfortable with pace, ambiguity, and having your attention split across a lot of moving parts at once.

What you’ll build and own

  • Core operations: Own core people operations processes including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, probation management, background checks, right-to-work, and leave and absence management.

  • HRIS data: Own our HRIS data integrity, maintain accurate records, run audits, build out workflows and automations that reduce manual data entry and admin as we scale.

  • Benefits administration: Manage enrolment, changes, and employee queries across benefits programmes.

  • AI integration: Own and maintain content for our AI HR bot so employees get fast, accurate self-serve answers, and act as our champion for identifying new ways AI tools can support the people function.

  • Employee and first-line manager support: Be the go-to for employee questions, manage our jira ticketing system

  • Ad-hoc projects: Support on People related projects, there’s a new HRIS implementation coming (amongst many other initiatives)!

  • People metrics and reporting: Produce reporting that gives the business visibility into what's working and what needs attention.

Your experience

  • 2+ years in a people operations or HR generalist roles, ideally spanning multiple countries

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, juggling multiple workstreams at once

  • Experience improving or automating a process, with an eye toward building for scale

  • Proficiency with modern HRIS platforms and comfort maintaining accurate, structured data

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth, multi-country startup environment

  • Experience supporting an HRIS implementation or migration


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.
